The '''Apex Vanguard''' was a mutant creature developed as a weapon inside [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. It was eventually killed by the team sent to handle the cleanup of the [[CI-004 Incident]].<ref name="TOR" />
